Private Function Tried(ByVal pt As Object, ByVal n As String) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Failed
    v = pt.GetData(n)
    Tried = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, s As String
    Dim n As Variant
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D5").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array("k", "p", "v", "q"), Array("a", "x", 1, "m"), Array("b", "y", 2, "n"), Array("a", "y", 3, "m"), Array("c", "x", 4, "n"))))
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("A1:D5")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("I3"), "PT")
    pt.PivotFields("k").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.PivotFields("p").Orientation = xlColumnField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("v"), "Sum of v", xlSum
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("q"), "Count of q", xlCount
    For Each n In Array("Sum of v", "'Sum of v'", "'Sum of v' a", "Sum of v a", "'Sum of v' k[a]", "'Sum of v' k['a']", "a", "'Sum of v' 'a'", "'Sum of v' x", "'Sum of v' a x", "'Sum of v' 'Grand Total'", "'Sum of v' zz", "", "'Count of q'", "'Count of q' b", "'Sum of v' A", "'sum of v' a", "Sum of v[a]", "'Sum of v' a y", "'Sum of v' k[a] p[x]", "'Sum of v' x a", "'Sum of v' b x", "'Sum of v' x y", "'Sum of v' a a", "'Sum of v' k[zz]", "'Sum of v' zz[a]", "'Sum of v' 'a", "'Sum of v' k[a", "v", "v a", "'Sum of v' Grand Total", "'Sum of v' grand total x", "Count of q Sum of v")
        s = s & "~" & Tried(pt, CStr(n))
    Next
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
